hero.heading: Jerrell Niu
hero.sub: I write every guide on this site, and I do the work I write about. I Love Digital is a one-person studio on the Gold Coast, so the person answering your questions is the person building the site.

bio.heading: Why I am worth reading on this.
paragraphs: Everything here comes out of client work, not research. I build the websites, run the search and reporting, and sit in the meetings where the results get explained, so each guide describes what actually moved the numbers on a real Australian business rather than what should work in theory.

The background behind that is twenty years across product, technology and business. I spent seven years at Coding Labs as Product Manager and then Executive Board Member, leading product across web and mobile and growing the engineering team by 500 per cent in three years. Before that I ran recruitment as General Manager at 99 Resumes and in technical recruitment leadership at MCS Consulting and Vanarden Mining Oil and Gas, and earlier still I spent six years in commercial finance. That mix means I have run teams, hired them, financed them and built the products they use, which is why the advice here is commercial before it is technical.

I started I Love Digital in 2024 to bring all of it together. Every article is written from the same standard I hold client work to: plain English, a clear answer in the first line, and no claim without something behind it.

items.title: Websites
items.body: Design and hands-on build across Next.js, Shopify, WordPress, Squarespace and Wix, with Figma for design. I write the code, so the guides cover what breaks as well as what works.

items.title: Search
items.body: Technical SEO, on-page work, Google Business Profile and AI search. Everything is measured in Google Search Console on live client accounts, which is where the figures in these guides come from.

items.title: Socials
items.body: Content calendars, captions and scripts for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, written for small teams who have to run them alongside the actual job.

items.title: Consulting
items.body: Fractional CTO work, AI automation and systems that take admin off a business owner's desk. This is where the tooling and workflow guides come from.

items.detail: Since 2024. Websites, search, social and consulting for Queensland trades, retailers and service businesses.
